soundness_argument: The visible result digest commits to column names, every visible value, and row order.
Source identities are stored in exactly the same order as visible result rows.
Therefore source identity i is bound to output identity (result_digest, i).
Independent verification recomputes both the visible result digest and every ordered source identity.
pilot_gates: All direct and V4 result digests agree.
All V4 artifacts pass independent verification.
Every required attack test is rejected.
Artifact storage approaches 32 bytes per edge.
No hidden instrumentation column appears in the visible result.
decision_policy: V3 remains the immutable formal baseline and is never overwritten.
V4 pilot measurements are development evidence, not paper performance evidence.
A formal V4 scale experiment is admitted only after semantic gates pass and the pilot shows a material implementation benefit.
If V4 does not materially improve storage and at least one major latency component, retain the result and stop record-lineage tuning.
